purpose: Authoritative expected-game inventory for the audited window. Layer-1 of the four-layer audit.
authority_note: Counts were NOT taken from the requester's stated totals. MLB 8/15 = 15 is derived independently: the 8/14 tier-1 finals board shows 14 games in progress as series, and PHI and MIN were the only two teams idle that day, so their series resumed 8/15 -> 14 continuations + PHI@MIN = 15. WNBA = 3 and NFL 8/15 = 7 were verified against league schedule sources.

rejected_phantom_games.why_rejected: San Diego was at Cleveland on 8/15 (series continuation from the tier-1 8/14 SD@CLE final); St. Louis was at Chicago. The listing came from a corrupted schedule summary in a contaminated capture session and matches no real series state.

egress_limitation: statsapi.mlb.com, site.api.espn.com, www.mlb.com and www.baseball-reference.com all return CONNECT tunnel 403 through this container's egress proxy. Official IDs are therefore present only where a repository artifact literally carries one. Absent IDs are null WITH A REASON, never guessed.
